note: Independent Horizons sample comparisons, including short-perihelion intervals. Numeric/source-request differences, NOT observational accuracy or uniform global bounds.
referenceQuerySpan: Local reference requests span no more than about 25 years each.
caution: Separate reference requests spanning hundreds of years produced larger differences (up to 97.436 km). The comparisons include source-request differences, not just interpolation. Neither comparison measures absolute orbital uncertainty.
